question: What will be the closing value of the euro to US dollar exchange rate (EURUSD=X on Yahoo Finance) on October 2, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the daily close of EURUSD=X on Yahoo Finance for 2026-10-02. If there is no close on that date (weekend or holiday), the last close before it is used.
baseline:
Computed by code from Yahoo Finance daily closes for EURUSD=X: latest close 1.1628 on 2026-09-03.
Target date 2026-10-02 is 21 trading observations ahead. Percentiles of the price on the target date,
from the empirical distribution of 21-observation returns over the last 3 years (last year weighted double):
p5: 1.1351, p10: 1.1406, p25: 1.1503, p50: 1.1648, p75: 1.1773, p90: 1.1896, p95: 1.1979
This ignores news and known events; adjust for them. Check the symbol matches the resolution source
(exchange, contract month, close vs settlement price).
research:
I have enough sources from before the cutoff, so I'm writing up the findings now. I left out anything published after 2026-09-04.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-09-03: The EURUSD=X close supplied by code was **1.1628**. I could not fetch Yahoo Finance directly. The question resolves on the Yahoo daily close for Friday 2026-10-02, which is a normal FX trading day.
- 2026-08-28: Before Warsh's speech, EUR/USD held at about 1.1645 with the dollar at a one-week high. [Vantage](https://www.vantagemarkets.com/market-analysis/eur-usd-forecast-august-28-2026-warsh-jackson-hole/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. Spot is about 1.163, near the middle of the 1.1 to 1.2 range, with about 21 trading days to go.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-01: Eurostat's flash estimate put euro area HICP at **3.3%** for August, up from 2.9% in July. Energy prices jumped because of the war involving Iran and disruption around the Strait of Hormuz. [Eurostat](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/products-euro-indicators/w/2-01092026-ap), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/business/2026/09/01/eurozone-inflation-jumps-to-33-in-august-as-energy-prices-surge)
- 2026-08-31: Danske Bank wrote that Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole speech pushed EUR/USD lower. Markets were treating a September Fed hike as close to a coin flip. [FXStreet/Danske](https://www.fxstreet.com/news/euro-warsh-speech-weighs-on-eur-against-us-dollar-danske-bank-202608310619)
- 2026-08-28/29: Warsh called the 2% PCE target "firm" and "fixed". EUR/USD fell about 0.34% to roughly 1.1611, and the dollar index reached its strongest level since Aug 19. [FinanceFeeds](https://financefeeds.com/warsh-turns-hawkish-at-jackson-hole-dollar-jumps-stocks-wobble-bitcoin-slips/), [Convera](https://convera.com/blog/market-insights/fx-research/daily-market-updates/a-hole-lot-riding-on-warsh/)
- 2026-08-21 (approx.): EUR/USD hit a 2-month high, around 1.17, ahead of the Fed minutes and Jackson Hole. [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/analysis/eurusd-hits-2month-high-before-fed-minutes-and-warshs-jackson-hole-debut-200685918)
- Context: Both the Fed and the ECB are in a tightening phase because of the energy shock. The ECB is fully priced to raise rates by 25bp on Sept 10. The Fed's September move is close to 50/50. [Morningstar](https://www.morningstar.com/economy/will-ecb-raise-interest-rates-again-2026-cut-them-2027), [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/fomc-september-2026-odds-rate-201618784.html)

## 4. Base rates
- These figures come from the code-supplied empirical distribution of 21-day returns over 3 years, using the latest close of 1.1628:
  - p5 1.1351, p10 1.1406, p25 1.1503
  - **p50 1.1648**
  - p75 1.1773, p90 1.1896, p95 1.1979
- That puts the 25-75% band at about ±1.1% and the 5-95% band at about ±3%. Under this baseline, the chance of finishing outside 1.10 to 1.20 is small, under 5% on each side.
- Recent trend: the pair has traded sideways, roughly 1.16 to 1.17, for about two months. Late August brought a modest pullback on dollar strength.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-06-19: ING raised its year-end 2026 EUR/USD forecast to **1.18**, put short-term fair value at about 1.160, and saw support above 1.140. [VT Markets summary](https://www.vtmarkets.com/?p=52899)
- An undated BitMEX blog lists a consensus Q3 2026 range of 1.18 to 1.25. I don't consider it reliable because no sources are named. [BitMEX](https://testnet.bitmex.com/blog/eur-usd-forecast-2026)
- I could not find a Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on the EUR/USD level, or a current Danske forecast with a specific number.
- Related market: Kalshi and Polymarket have Fed-decision markets, which DeFi Rate aggregates. Around Aug 31, pricing put the September hike near a coin flip, per Danske.

## 6. Upcoming events before Oct 2
- 2026-09-04: US August jobs report. Sources say a weak July report had pushed down the odds of a Fed hike. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/fomc-september-2026-odds-rate-201618784.html)
- 2026-09-10: ECB decision. A 25bp hike to a 2.50% deposit rate is fully priced, so guidance on further hikes matters most. [ECB calendar](https://www.financecalendar.com/event/ecb-rate-decision-september-2026/)
- Around 2026-09-10/11: US August CPI.
- 2026-09-16: FOMC decision plus a new dot plot. With pricing near a coin flip, this is the biggest scheduled risk for EUR/USD in either direction.
- Around 2026-09-17: Final August euro area HICP.
- Late September: US PCE inflation and euro area PMIs.
- 2026-10-01/02: Euro area September flash HICP, and possibly US September payrolls on Oct 2, the resolution day itself.
- Unscheduled: oil prices and Middle East / Strait of Hormuz developments. The energy shock hits the euro area harder, which has tended to weigh on the euro.
